notes.title: Demo v2.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

During the last week we have been listening to your feedback and have implemented various changes/fixes to the demo build. We have just pushed the update patch to live! A special thank you to everyone who left feedback!

Things that have changed include:
[list]
[*] Puzzle and tutorial fixes, to give better feedback to the player, especially in the start of the game.
[*] Huge performance improvements, the game should now run better on all devices!
[*] UI fixes and additions for more clarity
[*] Audio / SFX fixes
[/list]

Thank you all for playing and don't forget to share your feedback!
